title: AI Brand Theme Systems
outcome: One tokens file per brand generates web, Power Apps and Office themes, contrast-checked.
summary: Brand colours drift when they are copied by hand into apps, decks and Copilot Studio agents. I built a token pipeline that generates CSS, Tailwind, Power Apps and Office themes plus a WCAG report, used for my hampy brand and a DP World corporate theme in DPark.
cv: Inspired by: Build my own analytical tools and automations to speed up day-to-day work.

cards.title: hampy brand kit, drawn in code
cards.caption: Wordmark, mark tile and the 512px Copilot Studio agent icon are rectangles on a unit grid, generated by one script. Same palette everywhere.
cards.alt: hampy pixel wordmark on light and green tiles, mark tile and agent icon, with palette swatches

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: Tokens in Git, a Node build with tests and a contrast gate, and five generated files that land in web apps, Power Apps, Office templates and Copilot Studio.
cards.alt: Pipeline from tokens.json through build_themes.mjs to CSS, Tailwind, Power Apps, Office theme, contrast report and agent icon

cards.title: Token specimen
cards.caption: Generated from both tokens files: palette, roles and every tested text pair with its WCAG grade.
cards.alt: Two-column specimen of hampy and corporate palettes with contrast pair rows

cards.title: WCAG contrast in the build
cards.caption: The same formula runs in the build, the tests and the live checker on the demo page.

cards.title: Contrast results
cards.caption: Computed by the build. hampy passes every allowed pair; the corporate report flags white on the pink accent (3.71:1) as large text only.

cards.title: DPark in the corporate theme
cards.caption: The staff parking booking app (React, Tailwind, Netlify Functions) uses the same token values. Crops show no logo; the person search is covered.
cards.alt: DPark indigo side navigation and bay booking dialog with a pink confirm button, next to the generated token values

cards.title: Built with Claude Code
cards.body: Built with Claude Code and verified by 7 node tests covering the contrast maths and every generated file. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.
